# Determine last month based on current datetime in environment
now = datetime.now()
print('now:', now)
last_month_year = now.year
last_month_num = now.month - 1
if last_month_num == 0:
    last_month_num = 12
    last_month_year -= 1
last_month_str = f"{last_month_year:04d}-{last_month_num:02d}"

# Login file_system

receipt = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=receipt_path)
content = receipt.get('content','')
print('receipt content length:', len(content))
print('receipt snippet:', content[:200].replace('\n',' '))

m_total = re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)", content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
if not m_total:
    m_total = re.search(r"Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]{1,2})?)", content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
print('matched total:', m_total.group(1) if m_total else None)

total_amount = Decimal(m_total.group(1))
print('total_amount:', total_amount)
